paySlip.title: Pay Slip Generator
paySlip.description: Create a Korean wage statement with every legally required item. Overtime, night and holiday pay, social insurance and income tax (2026 withholding table) are calculated automatically, and you can save it as an A4 PDF.

sectionHint.info: Name and date of birth or employee number are mandatory.

ded.ins: Social insurance and income tax are calculated automatically. Edit an amount to override it.

modeHint.ins: Deducts pension, health, long-term care, employment insurance and wage income tax.
modeHint.biz: Only for freelance (business income) contracts. A person working under your direction is legally an employee.

paySlip.smallHint: The 50% overtime/night/holiday premium does not apply.
paySlip.ordinaryAuto: Leave empty to use base pay ÷ base hours = {value} KRW
paySlip.ordinaryManual: Using your ordinary hourly wage. Clear it to calculate automatically.

hoursHint.monthly: 40 hours a week = 209 hours (incl. weekly holiday). If fixed allowances are part of ordinary wages, enter the ordinary hourly wage yourself.
hoursHint.hourly: Weekly-holiday hours = weekly contract hours ÷ 40 × 8 × weeks in the month. Zero under 15 hours a week.

paySlip.premiumTitle: Overtime, night and holiday hours (monthly total)
paySlip.premiumHint: Overtime and holiday 1.5x, holiday over 8h 2x, night adds a 0.5x premium. Overtime at night goes in both fields.
paySlip.premiumHintSmall: Under 5 workers: overtime and holiday hours at 1x, no night premium.
paySlip.rowsEmpty: Add a meal allowance, bonus and more with the buttons below.
paySlip.dependentsHint: Count yourself and your spouse as 1 each. Children reduce the tax by 20,830 KRW (1) or 45,830 KRW (2).
paySlip.insBaseAuto: Leave empty to use taxable base pay and fixed allowances = {value} KRW (overtime and bonus only affect employment insurance)
paySlip.insBaseManual: Pension and health insurance use the base you entered.
paySlip.dedManual: Manual amount — press reset to calculate automatically

insight.noName: Enter the employee's name. It is a mandatory item.
insight.noId: Enter a date of birth or employee number so the employee can be identified.
insight.noPayDate: Enter the pay date. It is a mandatory item.
insight.negative: Deductions exceed total pay. Please check the amounts.
insight.minWageOk: Hourly equivalent {hourly} KRW meets the {year} minimum wage of {min} KRW.
insight.minWageOkHourly: Hourly wage {hourly} KRW meets the {year} minimum wage of {min} KRW.
insight.minWageLow: Below minimum wage: at least {required} KRW is required for {hours} hours a month, {short} KRW short (hourly {hourly} < {min} KRW).
insight.minWageLowHourly: Hourly wage {hourly} KRW is below the {year} minimum wage of {min} KRW.
insight.taxFreeOver: {name} is tax-free only up to {limit} KRW a month, so the extra {excess} KRW is treated as taxable.
insight.noMethod: Missing calculation method: {names}. Add the payment basis (e.g. fixed monthly).
insight.pensionCap: The insurance base exceeds the national pension cap of {cap} KRW, so the cap is used.
insight.pensionFloor: The insurance base is below the national pension floor of {floor} KRW, so the floor is used. Part-timers under 60 hours a month are usually not covered — set it to 0.
insight.otOver: {hours} overtime hours may exceed the 12-hours-a-week limit (about 52 a month).
insight.small: Under 5 workers: calculated without premiums. The pay slip obligation still applies.
insight.biz: 3.3% contractors are not employees, so no social insurance or wage income tax. If the person follows your working hours and instructions, they are an employee and must be enrolled.
insight.manual: Some deductions were edited manually. Compare them with the automatic values next month.

guide.title: Pay slips: what you need to know
guide.intro: If you employ even one person in Korea, you must issue a wage statement every payday. This tool fills in every legally required item and calculates overtime, night and holiday pay, social insurance and income tax for 2026. Your input stays in this browser.

sections.title: Obligation and fines
items: Required every payday since Nov 19, 2021 (Labor Standards Act Art. 48(2))
Applies to businesses of any size, including part-time and daily workers
Not issued: KRW 300,000 / 500,000 / 1,000,000 per worker for the 1st / 2nd / 3rd+ violation (max 5 million)
Missing or false items: KRW 200,000 / 300,000 / 500,000

sections.title: Mandatory items (Decree Art. 27-2)
items: Name, date of birth or employee number
Pay date and total wages
Amount of each item: base pay, allowances, bonus
Calculation method for hour-based items, including overtime, night and holiday hours
Each deduction and the total

sections.title: Tax-free items (2026)
items: Meal allowance up to KRW 200,000/month (when no free meals are provided)
Car allowance up to KRW 200,000/month (own car used for work)
Childbirth/childcare allowance up to KRW 200,000/month (children aged 6 or under)
Amounts above the limit are taxable for tax and insurance

sections.title: Premium pay
items: Ordinary hourly wage = monthly ordinary wage ÷ 209 hours (40h week)
Overtime: hourly × hours × 1.5
Night (10pm-6am): hourly × hours × 0.5 premium
Holiday: 1.5x up to 8 hours, 2x beyond
Businesses with 4 or fewer workers pay 1x (Decree Annex 1)

sections.title: Insurance and tax (employee share, 2026)
items: National pension 4.75% (base KRW 410,000-6,590,000)
Health insurance 3.595%, long-term care = health premium × 13.14%
Employment insurance 0.9%
Income tax: simplified withholding table (revised Feb 27, 2026); local tax 10% of income tax
3.3% contractors: 3% income tax + 0.3% local tax

sections.title: How to deliver
items: Print it, or send the PDF by email, KakaoTalk or text (electronic documents are valid)
Keep proof of delivery (sent log or signature)
Keep wage records for 3 years (Labor Standards Act Art. 42)
2026 minimum wage: KRW 10,320/hour, 2,156,880/month (209 hours)

items.q: What happens if an employer doesn't issue a pay slip?
items.a: Since November 19, 2021, Korean employers must issue a wage statement (paper or electronic) every time wages are paid (Labor Standards Act Art. 48(2)). Failure is subject to a fine of up to KRW 5 million; under Enforcement Decree Annex 7 it is KRW 300,000 / 500,000 / 1,000,000 per worker for the 1st / 2nd / 3rd+ violation. Missing or false items start at KRW 200,000.

items.q: Do businesses with fewer than 5 workers or part-timers need one?
items.a: Yes. The obligation applies to every employer with at least one worker, including part-time and daily workers. Businesses with 4 or fewer regular workers are exempt only from the 50% overtime/night/holiday premium, so extra hours are paid at 1x.

items.q: Can I send it via KakaoTalk or email?
items.a: Yes. Electronic documents are allowed, so email, text, KakaoTalk or an intranet are fine. Save a PDF here and send it, and keep the sent record as proof.

Under Enforcement Decree Art. 27-2: name and date of birth or employee number, pay date, total wages, amount of each item (base pay, allowances, bonus), the calculation method for items that depend on days or hours worked (including overtime, night and holiday hours), and each deduction and the total.

items.q: Is the KRW 200,000 meal allowance also excluded from social insurance?
items.a: A qualifying meal allowance up to KRW 200,000 a month is excluded from income tax and from the pension, health and employment insurance base. The excess is taxable. Car allowances and childcare allowances (children aged 6 or under) are also tax-free up to KRW 200,000 each.

It is looked up in the NTS simplified withholding table (Income Tax Enforcement Decree Annex 2, revised Feb 2026) using monthly taxable pay and the number of dependents, minus KRW 20,830 for one child aged 8-20 or KRW 45,830 for two. Workers may choose 80% or 120%. Local income tax is 10% of income tax. You can override any amount, e.g. in bonus months.
